source.name: Cyclingflash: Mathieu van der Poel races in blue jersey for Alpecin-Premier Tech again in 2026
source.quote: The men's team’s apparel is supplied by Kalas.
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. The Kalas 'K' logo also sits at the top of the jersey's left chest stack and on the thighs of the bib shorts (replica photos cited above).

summary: 2026 UCI WorldTeam kit by Kalas, revealed 1 January 2026: a return to blue, with 'Alpecin DMG SHAMPOO' above 'PREMIER TECH' across the chest and the back (Alpecin title sponsor since 2020, Premier Tech co-title partner from 2026). The right chest stack has the UCI WorldTeam badge (a UCI label, not a sponsor), Zwift, Canyon and Škoda; the left stack IKO, the Kalas logo (kit maker, listed as partner) and ABUS. Brustor and Deceuninck are on the collar, Premier Tech on the left sleeve, Alpecin DMG Shampoo on the right sleeve plus a small Alpecin patch on the left sleeve, and Canyon above the sleeve cuffs. Crelan sits on the upper back, Fenix (the brand that also names the women's team) on the lower back. The bib shorts carry Brustor across the seat, the Kalas logo on the thighs, Zwift on the front of the legs and Canyon above the hems. Marked complete: garment photos for front, back and bibs (Kalas replica pages) and 2026 race photos (Cor Vos via Domestique, kit maker's store) were all checked and match.
